message: Android 0.1.59 (60) is available through the official direct-download lane. On Huawei, Xiaomi, and other devices that use the compatibility system-gallery path, From system album now requests the shared photo-and-video collection instead of an image-only collection. CasePro opens a preferred system gallery directly only when it can handle image, video, and mixed-media picking; otherwise Android keeps control through the system resolver. The highest-update-source selection, unified external-share transaction safety, authentication, recovery, cleanup, and storage limits remain unchanged. The exact signed APK passed 824 automated tests with zero failures, full lint with zero errors, R8, APK v2 signature, 16 KiB alignment, signing checks, launch-readiness boundaries, and retained-data Redmi verification. Tencent AppBao currently continues to serve 0.1.53 (54); a store update is a separate submission and review.
